en.title: araS | Personal Asset, Portfolio & Retirement App
en.summary: Personal asset, portfolio and retirement tracker — designed, built and shipped to the App Store solo.
en.problem: Assets, liabilities, TW/US holdings, dividends and insurance policies sit scattered across banks, brokers and spreadsheets, so net worth is never visible at a glance — and no single tool handles multi-currency holdings, dividends and retirement projection together.
en.outcome: Built end to end alone: a Turborepo monorepo where a Next.js 15 web/API and an Expo iOS app share one API, one set of Zod schemas and one Clerk auth flow. Ten Prisma models, every query scoped to its userId. Version 1.6 is on the App Store with a RevenueCat premium subscription, Face ID lock, overseas stocks with a currency converter and a demo mode; Sentry watches for crashes, PostHog breaks down the paywall funnel, and updates ship over the air through EAS.

zh.title: araS｜個人資產、投資組合與退休試算 App
zh.summary: 個人資產、投資組合與退休試算 App，從產品設計、開發到上架 App Store 全程一人完成。
zh.problem: 資產、負債、台美股持股、股息與保單分散在各家銀行、券商與試算表，淨資產永遠看不到全貌；市面上也沒有一套工具能同時處理多幣別持股、股利與退休試算。
zh.outcome: 一人從頭做到底：以 Turborepo 讓 Next.js 15 網頁／API 與 Expo iOS App 共用同一套 API、Zod schema 與 Clerk 認證；Prisma 設計 10 個資料模型，每筆查詢都以 userId 隔離。目前 App Store 版本 1.6，含 RevenueCat Premium 訂閱、Face ID 鎖定、海外股票與換匯計算、示範模式；以 Sentry 監控當機、PostHog 拆解付費漏斗，日常更新透過 EAS OTA 推送。

en.title: reteP | Food & Calorie Tracking App
en.summary: Daily food and calorie logging — web app, iOS app and FastAPI backend, all built solo.
en.problem: Most food-logging apps can't find the dishes people in Taiwan actually eat, and any extra step between a meal and the log is enough to make people stop after a few days.
en.outcome: Built a FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend that imports thousands of Taiwanese foods from the Taiwan FDA nutrition database, verifies Clerk JWTs so each user only sees their own data, and runs on Zeabur. The web PWA adds AI photo recognition through an n8n workflow. Then ported the web UI one-to-one into an Expo app on the same backend and auth, shipped to the App Store on 19 Aug 2026 with Sign in with Apple, macro rings, yearly trend charts and a personal food library.

zh.title: reteP｜飲食與熱量紀錄 App
zh.summary: 每日飲食與熱量紀錄，網頁版、iOS App 與 FastAPI 後端皆由我一人完成。
zh.problem: 多數飲食 App 的食物庫查不到台灣人常吃的食物；而記錄只要多一個步驟，就很難一天三餐天天持續。
zh.outcome: 以 FastAPI + PostgreSQL 建後端，匯入食藥署上千筆台灣食物營養資料，Clerk JWT 驗簽讓每位使用者只能存取自己的資料，部署於 Zeabur；網頁版 PWA 以 n8n 串接 AI 拍照辨識熱量。再把網頁 UI 1:1 移植成 Expo App，共用同一組後端與認證，2026/08/19 上架 App Store，支援 Sign in with Apple、營養素環圈、年度趨勢圖與個人食物庫。

en.title: U-Turn | Badminton Team-Making & Court Scheduling PWA
en.summary: A badminton team-making and court-scheduling PWA, built with a friend — I led the UI redesign.
en.problem: Before every badminton session someone has to sort players into teams by hand, juggling headcount, gender and who has played how many games — slow, and rarely fair.
en.outcome: Rules generate rotating 2v2 games across multiple courts: at most one woman per pair, nobody plays or sits out more than two games in a row, and repeat pairings are avoided. The host signs in to run the session; players join with a code and watch it live. I redesigned the sign-in, home, player-select and schedule screens, writing the design spec first and then building the dark stage-style player picker and bottom-sheet alerts.

zh.title: U-Turn｜羽球自動分隊與排場 PWA
zh.summary: 羽球活動自動分隊與場次安排 PWA，與朋友合作開發，我負責 UI 重構與視覺設計。
zh.problem: 羽球團每次開打前，都要有人手動依人數、性別與上場次數排隊伍，既耗時又很難排得公平。
zh.outcome: 依規則自動產生多場地的 2v2 輪替：每隊最多一名女生、不連續上場或休息超過兩場、盡量避免重複搭配。主揪登入後安排場次，球友輸入代號就能即時觀看。我負責登入頁、首頁、選人頁與賽程頁的 UI 重構，先寫設計規格，再實作深色舞台風格的選人畫面與底部提示元件。

en.title: AI Research | Tech Trend Watching & Decision-Support Platform
en.summary: A trend-watching and decision-support platform for the MOEA Department of Industrial Technology, tracking emerging tech, industry news and early weak signals. I am the main frontend developer.
en.problem: Policy and investment calls depend on spotting global tech trends early, but the signals are scattered across news, papers, open-source communities and startup data — gathered by hand, with no way to tell a faint new signal from a mainstream one.
en.outcome: Built the whole frontend in Next.js 14. Deep Research streams its reports through an SSE proxy that injects heartbeats while the upstream is idle, so the gateway never drops the connection. Around it: a STEEP trend map, a leader radar, a tech-portfolio decision center with fishbone backcasting and Delphi expert review, a startup match board and a daily AI newsletter. Content is personalized by the user's industry, and signed share codes open selected reports without a login.

zh.title: AI 快研究｜科技趨勢觀測與決策支援平台
zh.summary: 經濟部技術司的趨勢觀測與決策支援平台，追蹤前瞻技術、產業動態與早期弱信號；我是主要前端開發者。
zh.problem: 政策與投資判斷需要及早掌握全球技術趨勢，但訊號散落在新聞、論文、開源社群與新創資料裡，只能人工蒐集，也分不出哪些是剛冒出的微光、哪些已是主流。
zh.outcome: 以 Next.js 14 打造全站前端：Deep Research 以 SSE 串流代理即時呈現研究報告，上游閒置時注入 heartbeat 避免閘道斷線；另有 STEEP 趨勢圖譜、領袖雷達、技術投資組合決策中心（魚骨圖回推與 Delphi 專家評估）、新創媒合看板與每日 AI 電子報。登入後依使用者產業別個人化內容，並以簽章分享碼開放免登入的報告分享頁。

en.title: Digital Chatroom | Multi-Venue AI Guide Chatbot
en.summary: One codebase, switched by environment variables, powering AI guide chatbots for venues such as a planetarium and several historical-figure guides.
en.problem: Each venue wanted its own AI guide, each with different branding, languages and features — rebuilding a chat interface every time was too costly and impossible to maintain.
en.outcome: Designed an env-driven architecture where branding, speech-to-text, login, knowledge-base editing and API endpoints all come from config; the same codebase now runs six branded deployments plus a shared-contract version. Chat streams LLM replies token by token with cited sources, alongside knowledge-base management, multilingual speech-to-text, speech synthesis, translation history and guest login, with CSP headers controlling which sites may embed it.

zh.title: 數位聊天室｜多場館 AI 導覽聊天機器人
zh.summary: 一套程式碼、以環境變數切換的 AI 導覽聊天室，已上線為天文館、李登輝、雍正帝、愛因斯坦等多個導覽專案。
zh.problem: 不同場館都想要自己的 AI 導覽員，品牌樣式、語言與功能需求各不相同；每次重寫一套聊天介面，成本太高也難以維護。
zh.outcome: 設計環境變數驅動的架構，品牌樣式、語音轉文字、登入、知識庫是否可編輯與 API 端點都由設定檔控制，同一套程式碼已上線 6 個品牌專案與一個共同契約版本。聊天支援 LLM 逐字串流回應與引用來源，另有知識庫管理、多語語音轉文字、語音合成、翻譯紀錄與訪客登入，並以 CSP 標頭控管可嵌入的網域。

en.title: LandScape Industry Map | IT Service Provider Search & Company Relationship Graph
en.summary: An industry map of Taiwan's IT service providers, bringing company profiles, categories and offerings together for internal decision-making and industry analysis.
en.problem: Finding the right IT service provider meant cross-checking company registries, OTC market data and subsidy records by hand — the data was scattered, filtering was clumsy, and investment and shareholding ties between companies were invisible.
en.outcome: Browse companies by industry area and filter by capital, headcount, capability registration, subsidies and product category; each company page draws its investment and shareholding ties with Cytoscape.js. Filter state is split into Jotai atoms so changing one condition no longer recomputes the whole graph. Conversational search, crawler settings and data import round it out, with Cypress E2E tests, Husky hooks and Semgrep scans guarding quality.

zh.title: LandScape ｜資訊服務業者查詢與企業關係圖譜
zh.summary: 台灣資訊服務業的產業地圖，整合企業資料、產業分類與產品服務，提供內部決策與產業分析。
zh.problem: 要找到合適的資訊服務業者，得在公司登記、櫃買中心與補助資料之間來回比對；資料分散、篩選不直覺，也看不出企業之間的投資與持股關係。
zh.outcome: 依產業領域瀏覽企業，支援資本額、員工數、能量登錄、獲補助紀錄、產品類別等多條件篩選；企業詳情以 Cytoscape.js 呈現投資與持股關係圖。篩選狀態以 Jotai 原子化拆分，避免任一條件變動就重算整張圖；另提供對話式搜尋、爬蟲設定與資料匯入，並以 Cypress E2E、Husky 與 Semgrep 掃描把關品質。

en.title: Agent Fabric | AI Agent Building Platform for Businesses
en.summary: A Dify-like platform that helps IT service providers build their own AI agents. I took over and led the frontend.
en.problem: IT service providers wanted to adopt AI, but building an agent from scratch is a high bar, existing tools are hard to customize, and connecting them to a company's own documents and databases is harder still.
en.outcome: Delivered three modules: the Architect, which generates an agent from a plain-language request; the Studio, which combines agents into applications; and the Knowledge Base, with multi-file upload and SQL database creation. Chat messages render Markdown, highlighted code, images, video and audio, with voice recording as input; the oversized Chat component was split into focused sub-components for readability and maintenance.

zh.title: Agent Fabric｜企業 AI Agent 建置平台
zh.summary: 協助資訊服務業者快速建立自己 AI Agent 的平台（類 Dify），我接手並主導前端開發。
zh.problem: 資訊服務業者想導入 AI，但從零打造 Agent 門檻高、現有工具難以客製，也不容易接上自家的文件與資料庫。
zh.outcome: 完成三大模組：輸入需求即可生成 Agent 的「架構師」、組合多個 Agent 成應用的「工作室」，以及支援多檔上傳與建立 SQL 資料庫的「知識庫」。對話訊息支援 Markdown、程式碼高亮與圖片／影音渲染，並加入語音錄音輸入；將大型 Chat 元件拆成獨立子元件，提升可讀性與維護性。

en.title: Nivorae | Website for a Three-Engineer Software Studio
en.summary: The bilingual website of Nivorae, a software studio I run with two other engineers — I built the frontend for the portfolio, plans and team pages and the contact flow.
en.problem: Clients choosing a small studio want proof of craft, a clear process and plain commercial terms before they get in touch; a generic template site says none of that, and for a studio that sells front-end work the site itself is the portfolio.
en.outcome: Built on Vite, React and TypeScript with Traditional Chinese and English routes. I built the portfolio page, whose parallax masonry hero takes over the wheel and touch scroll, eases it with a lerp loop and moves the columns with GPU transforms only, letting the page scroll on once the columns end; plus an animated "why us" building illustration, the animated plans-page hero, the redesigned team hero, and the contact and feedback forms wired to the API, with testimonials read from it. Each route is prerendered with its JSON-LD for crawlers, Claude Code reviews every PR, and the site runs on Zeabur.

zh.title: Nivorae｜三人軟體開發團隊官網
zh.summary: 與另外兩位工程師共組的軟體開發團隊 Nivorae 的中英雙語官網；我負責作品集、方案、團隊頁與聯絡表單的前端開發。
zh.problem: 客戶挑選小型開發團隊時，想先看到作品品質、清楚的合作流程與白紙黑字的商務條件才願意聯繫；套版官網說不出這些，而對一個接前端案子的團隊來說，官網本身就是作品集。
zh.outcome: 以 Vite + React + TypeScript 建站，提供繁中與英文路由。我負責作品集頁：視差瀑布流主視覺接管滾輪與觸控捲動，以 lerp 迴圈緩動，只用 GPU transform 移動各欄，欄位捲到底才把捲動還給頁面；另做了「為什麼選我們」的建築動畫插圖、方案頁動態主視覺、團隊頁主視覺改版，以及串接 API 的諮詢與回饋表單，客戶評價也改由 API 讀取。各路由預先渲染並附 JSON-LD 給搜尋引擎，每個 PR 由 Claude Code 審查，部署於 Zeabur。

en.title: Little Daily Website | A Podcast Brand Site Built with Claude Code
en.summary: The website for the podcast Little Daily — from the mobile layout to a personality quiz and a listener mailbox, built and shipped with Claude Code.
en.problem: The show needed a home for its listeners — somewhere to introduce the podcast and let people take part and send in their stories — with one person to build a polished mobile experience in little time.
en.outcome: Built on Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS 4, with Claude Code reproducing a reference design's layout, spacing and interactions from measured values. It has a personality quiz whose answers combine into a shareable card (downloadable as a 1080×1350 image), a "letter to the sea" submission page, a story collection and an unlisted podcast mailbox; submissions are stored in Upstash Redis and relayed to Discord. A CLAUDE.md records the project's conventions, Claude Code hooks block malformed commits and PRs opened from the main branch, and an llms.txt helps AI search understand the site.

zh.title: 微小日常官網｜以 Claude Code 開發的 Podcast 品牌網站
zh.summary: Podcast「微小日常」的官網，從手機版版型、心理測驗到聽眾留言箱，全程以 Claude Code 開發並上線。
zh.problem: 節目需要一個承接聽眾的地方：介紹節目、讓聽眾參與互動與投稿；但只有一個人開發，要在短時間內做出細緻的手機版體驗。
zh.outcome: 以 Next.js 16 + Tailwind CSS 4 建站，由 Claude Code 依參考設計的實測值重現版型、間距與互動。網站有心理測驗與依作答組合產生的分享小卡（可下載 1080×1350 圖片）、「大海裡的信」投稿、故事集與不公開的 Podcast 留言箱，投稿以 Upstash Redis 保存並推送到 Discord。專案以 CLAUDE.md 記錄開發慣例，用 Claude Code hooks 擋下格式不符的 commit 與從主分支開的 PR，並提供 llms.txt 讓 AI 搜尋讀懂網站。

en.title: Custom Claude Skills | Development Workflow Written for AI
en.summary: Spec-writing, testing and App Store lessons written down as reusable Claude Code skills, so AI follows the same process every time.
en.problem: AI writes code fast, but every new conversation means explaining the rules again; specs come back with open questions nobody decided, and the same testing and release pitfalls get hit over and over.
en.outcome: Wrote a set of skills for my own work. spec-autopilot makes the AI check a spec for gaps and decide every open question before handing it over. web-to-ios-expo-app turns the five stages of taking a web app to iOS — skeleton, UI port, EAS and App Store submission, Sentry and RevenueCat, OTA updates — into steps with checkpoints. Others cover Clerk auth setup, moving Clerk to production and diagnosing SEO and link previews. Work then runs spec → review → TDD → verification → AI code review. In the Nivorae studio repo the same flow is wired in for the whole team: /planning:spec, /planning:review and /planning:apply-review settle the plan, hooks block secrets, scoped commits and PRs from the wrong branch on every edit, a Stop hook runs lint, types and tests before Claude may call a task done, and every PR to develop gets a Claude Code Review in CI. This portfolio site was built the same way.

zh.title: 自製 Claude Skills｜把開發流程寫成 AI 的工作規範
zh.summary: 把規格撰寫、測試與上架的經驗寫成可重用的 Claude Code skills，讓 AI 每次都照同一套流程開發。
zh.problem: AI 寫程式很快，但每開一次新對話就要重新交代規範；規格常留下沒人決定的問題，測試與上架的坑也一再重踩。
zh.outcome: 寫出一組自用 skill：spec-autopilot 讓 AI 交出規格前先自我檢查缺漏、自行決定所有待定問題；web-to-ios-expo-app 把網頁改做 iOS App 的五個階段（骨架、UI 移植、EAS 與 App Store 上架、Sentry 與 RevenueCat、OTA 更新）寫成步驟與檢查點；另有 Clerk 認證設定、Clerk 正式環境搬遷與 SEO／分享預覽診斷。開發時依 spec → 審查 → TDD → 驗證 → AI code review 的流程進行。在 Nivorae 團隊的 repo 裡，這套流程直接寫進專案：以 /planning:spec、/planning:review 與 /planning:apply-review 定案計畫；每次寫檔都由 hooks 擋下敏感檔、不合格式的 commit 與從錯誤分支開的 PR；Stop hook 跑完 lint、型別與測試，Claude 才能宣告完成；每個合進 develop 的 PR 都在 CI 由 Claude Code Review 審查。這個作品集網站也是這樣完成的。

en.title: Caregiver Payroll Automation | AI Reads Handwritten Timesheets
en.summary: Hands an accountant's monthly caregiver timesheets — handwritten and scanned — to Claude, which works out the pay and produces the Excel report.
en.problem: Every month the accountant checks handwritten caregiver timesheets line by line, converts them into care ratios, shifts and amounts, and types it all into Excel. The rules are detailed and the forms many, so it is slow and easy to get wrong — and the accountant does not code.
en.outcome: Claude reads each scanned PDF by following a custom skill and writes one JSON file per caregiver. A Python engine applies the billing rules — splitting time into segments and working out days, shifts and amounts — then uses Excel COM to copy last month's layout into a new monthly report, a preview PDF and a list of items to confirm. The accountant double-clicks a batch file and answers Claude's questions in Chinese. Checked against the hand-made September report, all 78 entries for two caregivers match cell for cell.

zh.title: 看護費月報表自動化｜AI 讀手寫工作表算出看護費
zh.summary: 把會計每月手寫掃描的照顧服務員工作表交給 Claude 讀取，自動算出看護費並產出 Excel 報表。
zh.problem: 每個月會計都要對照手寫的照顧服務員工作表，逐筆換算照顧比例、班別與金額，再填進 Excel；規則細、表單多，既耗時又容易算錯，而會計本身不會寫程式。
zh.outcome: Claude 依自訂 skill 讀取掃描檔 PDF，每位看護員整理成一份 JSON；Python 計算引擎依計費規則切時段、算出日／班／節與金額，再以 Excel COM 複製上個月的格式，產出新月份報表、預覽 PDF 與待確認清單。會計只要點兩下批次檔、用中文回答 Claude 的問題即可。以 115 年 9 月的人工報表驗算，兩位看護員共 78 筆逐格一致。

en.title: Daily Weather Push | n8n + AI Weather Reminders on LINE
en.summary: An n8n workflow that pulls the Central Weather Administration forecast, has AI turn it into a plain reminder, and sends it to LINE every morning.
en.problem: Checking the weather before heading out means opening an app and deciding for yourself whether to take an umbrella or a jacket; the forecast is a wall of numbers that doesn't say what matters today.
en.outcome: Built a scheduled n8n workflow: each morning it calls the Central Weather Administration's open-data API for the local forecast, passes it to an LLM that turns temperature and rain chance into a few plain-language tips — take an umbrella, bring a jacket — and pushes them out through LINE. No backend or server to write; changing the message means editing a node or the prompt.

zh.title: 每日天氣推播｜n8n + AI 每天早上送天氣提醒到 LINE
zh.summary: 用 n8n 排程抓取中央氣象署預報，交給 AI 寫成白話提醒，每天早上推播到 LINE。
zh.problem: 出門前得自己打開 App 查天氣、判斷要不要帶傘或加外套；預報是一堆數字，一眼看不出今天該注意什麼。
zh.outcome: 在 n8n 建立排程工作流：每天早上呼叫中央氣象署開放資料 API 取得當地預報，交給 LLM 依氣溫與降雨機率整理成幾句白話提醒（要不要帶傘、加外套），再透過 LINE 推播送出。不需要寫後端或架伺服器，想調整內容只要改節點或 prompt。

en.title: Podcast Tool | On-Device Transcription + AI-Written Show Notes
en.summary: Built for the podcast Little Daily: drop in an episode and get Traditional Chinese subtitles and a transcript on your own machine, then show notes Claude writes to the show's own rules.
en.problem: Before each episode goes out someone has to transcribe it for subtitles, pick chapters and quotes, and write a title and description — hours of work per episode — while generic AI copy comes out formulaic and off-tone for the show.
en.outcome: A Python pipeline chains FFmpeg preprocessing, faster-whisper speech recognition, pyannote speaker diarization and OpenCC conversion with a custom glossary, producing .srt subtitles and a speaker-labelled transcript locally — the audio never leaves the computer. Claude then writes the show notes from a custom skill that encodes the show's voice, and the tool checks that every chapter time, quote and number matches the transcript before writing the final files. A side-by-side test against a local Qwen model, which came out formulaic and got a fact wrong, settled on Claude and freed about 25 GB.

zh.title: Podcast 處理工具｜本機語音辨識 + AI 撰寫上架文案
zh.summary: 為 Podcast「微小日常」打造：丟入音檔，在本機產出繁中字幕與逐字稿，再由 Claude 依節目規範寫上架文案。
zh.problem: 每集上架前都要聽打字幕、整理章節與金句、寫標題與節目描述，一集就要花好幾個小時；交給一般 AI 寫，又常是制式、不符合節目調性的文案。
zh.outcome: 以 Python 串起 FFmpeg 前處理、faster-whisper 語音辨識、pyannote 講者分離，以及 OpenCC 簡轉繁與自訂詞庫校正，在本機產出 .srt 字幕與標好講者的逐字稿，音檔不離開電腦。文案由 Claude 依自訂 skill 寫成的節目規範撰寫，工具再自動檢查章節時間、金句與數字都對得上逐字稿，全部通過才輸出。也曾與本機 Qwen 模型並排比較，Qwen 文案較制式還寫錯事實，最後統一改用 Claude，並省下約 25GB 空間。

en.title: Campus Gender Equality Program
en.summary: Government-funded campus programme on gender equality and personal safety.
en.problem: Traditional education lacks systematic gender and safety advocacy.
en.outcome: Managed gov bids, coordinated 30+ seminars in 6 months, reaching 1,000+ students and staff.

zh.title: 校園性別平權宣講計畫
zh.summary: 政府標案：校園多元性別與自我保護宣講計畫。
zh.problem: 既有教育體系缺乏多元性別與自我保護的系統性宣導。
zh.outcome: 承接並執行政府標案，半年內統籌 30+ 場講座，精準觸及超過 1,000 名學生與教職人員。

en.problem: Low awareness and fundraising difficulty for vulnerable groups like teen pregnancy.
en.outcome: Partnered with Far Eastern Dept. Store, leveraging CSR resources to raise 100k+ in a single event.

zh.title: 百貨 CSR 異業結盟

zh.outcome: 促成與遠東百貨跨界合作，結合企業 CSR 資源提升品牌能見度，單檔活動募得逾 10 萬元善款。

en.problem: Offline fundraising limited by geography, making it hard to scale.
en.outcome: Implemented digital strategies, optimized donation paths, successfully raised 700k.

zh.title: 數位轉型募款專案

zh.outcome: 導入數位行銷策略突破地域限制，優化線上捐款路徑，成功募資達 70 萬元。
